findings.description: AC-1 excludes only the placeholder `- -` from items, but the Rationale placeholder the tool writes is `-`. Under AC-1 a Rationale body of `-` is one item, so filling an empty Rationale by replace counts removedItems 1 and AC-4 refuses it without --confirm-replace, while AC-6 says a body holding only the placeholder writes without the flag and reports removedItems 0, and the Research note says counting the placeholder would wrongly demand confirmation to fill an empty section. The two ACs cannot both hold on a real input.

evidence.detail: src/core/mutation/render-requirement.ts:93 `...(input.rationale ? [input.rationale] : ["-"])` versus :48 `if (!value) return ["- -"];` (Research and Implementation Notes only). Scratch copy of test/fixtures/workspaces/mutation-target: `add-requirement` without a rationale left Rationale body line 102 = `-`; `append-note FR-ARCH-002 --section rationale --mode replace --text "Filled rationale" --dry-run --json` returned replaceRange startLine 102 endLine 102, so that line is the replaced body. FR-NODE-270 AC-1: 'a non-blank line at the start of the body ... starts an item ... the template placeholder line `- -` and blank lines are not items'; AC-6: 'the body holds only the placeholder ... SHALL write without the confirmation flag and report removedItems: 0'. docs/spec holds 135 Rationale bodies that are exactly `-` (e.g. 10.product-architecture.srs.md:603).
